description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Kumbukka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530176 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and related property rights. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
